title: dedicated-autoscaler-priority-routing-burst-util-reporting-enhancement-v42
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Enhances dedicated autoscaler with priority-aware routing for burst windows, improves utilization reporting and adds throughput guarantee metrics. No customer-facing API changes.
description: Context: customers running Dedicated fleets have requested smoother burst behaviour for mixed-priority workloads and better observability into burst consumption and per-priority throughput guarantees. This PR implements: 1) priority-aware routing in the dedicated autoscaler to preferentially allocate burst tokens to high-priority routes during transient spikes; 2) token-bucket smoothing adjustments to reduce oscillation when multiple priorities compete; 3) per-priority throughput guarantee metrics and a new utilization report endpoint; 4) dashboard widgets and runbook updates. Changes are behind feature flags and gated by a rollout plan. Motivation: reduce tail latency and avoid eviction of high-priority traffic when low-priority workloads create short-lived spikes. Scope: autoscaler logic, metrics/telemetry, reporting API, and docs. Checklist: - [x] design doc (ENG-1421) linked - [x] unit + integration tests added - [x] perf benchmarks (no regressions at p95) - [x] rollout plan with canary config - [x] dashboards and runbook updated Rollout notes: feature flag "priority_burst_v2" off by default; enable on a single fleet for canary, monitor new metrics (priority_burst_consumed, priority_throughput_guarantee), then gradually enable. Related: ENG-1789, SUP-9042.
